subject: general
question: From which of the following states was Vibrant Village programme launched, on 10 April 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Vibrant Village programme was launched from **Arunachal Pradesh** on 10 April 2023.
 
• The programme aims to enhance the quality of life for people living in border villages, ensuring sustainable development and improving infrastructure.
 
• It focuses on areas such as education, health, agriculture, and connectivity to ensure comprehensive growth.
 
• Special emphasis is placed on empowering local communities and promoting tourism to generate livelihood opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is known for its unique cultural heritage and scenic beauty, making it a crucial region for such developmental programmes.
 
• The Vibrant Village programme is a part of the government's broader strategy to bolster border security and enhance the living standards of border communities.
 
• By improving the infrastructure in these remote areas, the programme also aims to curb migration to urban areas, thereby maintaining the demographic stability of border regions.
